parameters.content:
## Stage 6 — Job Status Check (Phase 1)

Reads **OJS BOQ & SMV** + **Operative Job Sheet**, groups by SmartForm Name (job).

**Production skip:**
- **Skip entirely** — Completed date + Ready To Hand over = Yes + inputs unchanged
- **Code only** — Completed date, code blockers (Q2.2/Q3.1), or unchanged WIP (jeopardy refreshed hourly)
- **AI** — No Completed date, no blockers, inputs changed (BOQ vs Q2.1 scope check)

**Job Status:**
1. **completed** — `Completed` date set
2. **completed** — **BCC Tracker Status** = Complete (notes if completed date missing)
3. **completed** — AI confirms scope complete (no EasyBOP date)
4. **incomplete** — otherwise

**Jeopardy (incomplete + Appointment Date):**
1. **next_appointment_needed** — next appt blank or past
2. **manager_review** — time > 105% SMV

Loop batch 5: AI jobs only → Parse → loop; done → Flush → sheet.

values.content:
You assess whether a BCC Response Repairs JOB (overall property scope) is COMPLETED or INCOMPLETE.

Use THREE layers of evidence (all matter). When they conflict, trust operative answers over Q2.1 wording:

1) Q2.2 "Were you able to complete your work in full?" — per visit, newest last.
   - Latest visit No → INCOMPLETE (even if Q2.1 lists tasks done).
   - Latest visit not explicitly Yes → INCOMPLETE.
   - Q2.2 Yes on a visit means THAT VISIT only — it does NOT prove the whole job/BOQ is finished.

2) Q3.1 / Q2.5 / Q2.8 — return visits, extra coats pending, drying time, stain block still to do, outstanding work → INCOMPLETE.
   Example: "Need to return to stain block as an extra, plus 2 coats, need time for each coat to dry" → INCOMPLETE.

3) BOQ vs Q2.1 — lenient practical match for scope coverage ONLY when Q2.2/Q3.1 do not block completion.

COMPLETED only when ALL are true:
- Latest Q2.2 is explicitly Yes
- No Q3.1/Q2.5/Q2.8 signals of return or outstanding work on any visit
- BOQ scope appears addressed in Q2.1 across visits

If PRE-CHECK BLOCKERS are listed (not "none"), you MUST return job_status incomplete.

Also comment on time: compare time_spent_hours vs smv_allowed_hours (lenient — over by up to 25% is still acceptable).

When EasyBOP has no works completed date, your job_status answer is used on the sheet if scope appears fully delivered in OJS.

Return ONLY valid JSON matching the schema. No markdown.
